title: The Hull Taggers
logline: When an underground vacuum racer dies in a high-speed debris sprint, their mechanic discovers the syndicate sponsor rigged the reactor shielding for insurance.

roles.description: Finances the illegal hull-tagging syndicate; views young fliers as disposable fuel for viewing wagers.
A veteran tuner who rebuilt the victim's interceptor and noticed deliberate cuts in the heat exchanger.
An automated security picket guarding the wreckage in the scrap field.
An armed interceptor sent by the sponsor to erase flight telemetry from the derelict racer.
A pressurized hangar welded inside a derelict freighter where outlaw interceptors are modified.
A dense asteroid and wreckage ring where the illegal tagging derby is flown.
The outlaw wagering ring that broadcasts high-speed hull runs to private station lounges.

public_situation: Bookmakers across {system} are mourning an outlaw sprint pilot killed after colliding with reactor debris during the midnight derby.
private_truth: The syndicate sponsor secretly vented the racer's cooling fluid to cause a fatal engine flameout and claim a massive contingency insurance payout.

beats.public_change: The racing syndicate suspends tag flights while clearing debris from the main sprint run.

missions.reason: The mechanic hires an outsider to scan the crashed interceptor before the syndicate's scrap tugs crush the evidence.
missions.private_fact: Telemetry proves the ship's reactor safety interlock was manually overridden from the sponsor's pit terminal.

beats.public_change: Syndicate sweepers lock down the approach vector with armed picket drones.

missions.reason: The mechanic asks the pilot to destroy the security drone guarding the wreck and recover the severed cooling manifold.
missions.private_fact: The manifold has a physical drill hole through the primary intake pipe disguised as collision wear.

beats.public_change: An armed cutter bearing the sponsor's corporate livery moves to intercept incoming couriers.

missions.reason: The mechanic begs the pilot to disable the cutter before it burns down the paddock and executes the crew.
missions.private_fact: The cutter captain hails mid-fight, offering a cut of the insurance settlement if the pilot surrenders the drilled manifold.

beats.public_change: Outlaw pilots assemble in the paddock as word of the rigged collision spreads through the berths.

missions.reason: The mechanic asks the pilot to deliver the drilled manifold directly to the pilots' council before the sponsor flees.
missions.private_fact: The mechanic owes three years of back hangar rent to the sponsor that will be enforced if the case fails.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the drilled manifold before the enraged paddock fliers. The sponsor begs for a quiet buyout, while the fliers demand the sponsor's execution.

options.label: Present the drilled manifold to the fliers to dismantle the crooked syndicate
Force the sponsor to sign an enforceable pilot safety covenant funded by the insurance pool
Sell the manifold back to the sponsor for personal credits

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot presents the drilled manifold to the pilots' council.
resolutions.summary: Outlaw pilots sack {role:syndicate_sponsor}'s offices and dissolve {role:racing_syndicate}, while {role:paddock_mechanic} takes over the empty paddock.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot proved a racing sponsor drilled holes in a champion's engine for insurance scrip.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot forces the sponsor to sign a pilots' safety pact.
resolutions.summary: {role:syndicate_sponsor} pays restitution to the dead flier's estate and funds a mutual paddock fund managed by {role:paddock_mechanic}.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the payoff or sells the manifold.
resolutions.summary: {role:syndicate_sponsor} collects the insurance windfall and silences {role:paddock_mechanic}, cementing total control over {role:racing_syndicate}.

resolutions.reached_by: The deliveries fail or the pilot drops the contract.
resolutions.summary: The wreck is incinerated as routine scrap; {role:syndicate_sponsor} collects the insurance while the dead racer is blamed for reckless flying.

loose_threads.detail: The crash telemetry transponder was calibrated using commercial fleet navigation keys registered to an offshore broker.
An insurance syndicate posted an anomalous ten-million credit policy on the doomed racer twenty-four hours before launch.

radio_hooks: Tragic collision in {system} outer belt claims life of outlaw sprint champion.
Habitat betting boards freeze payouts pending crash telemetry certification.
Outlaw racing syndicate announces memorial fly-by across junkyard approach vectors.

voice_direction.syndicate_sponsor: Charming, patronizing, speaking with glossy executive polish and dismissing mortal danger as cost of doing business.
voice_direction.paddock_mechanic: Tired, hoarse, speaking in blunt monosyllables with suppressed grief and sharp mechanical specificity.
